volcengine/OpenViking.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
score_reasons: topics: agent-memory, agent-plugins, agentic-rag, context-database, dsh-plugin
volcengine/OpenViking.readme_summary: Website  ·  Live Demo  ·  GitHub  ·  Issues  ·  Docs
readme_features: One filesystem for all context. Memories, resources, and skills each get a viking:// URI. Agents locate and manipulate context deterministically, like a developer working with files. → Viking URI · Context types
Tiered loading cuts token spend. Every entry is processed into L0 (abstract), L1 (overview), and L2 (details) on write, then loaded only as deep as the task requires. → Context layers
Directory recursive retrieval. Vector search first locates the highest-scoring directory, then drills down layer by layer, so results arrive with their surrounding context intact. → Retrieval
Observable retrieval. Each query preserves its directory-browsing trajectory. When a result looks wrong, you can see exactly which path produced it. → Retrieval
Sessions become memory. After a session commits, OpenViking asynchronously extracts user preferences and agent experience into long-term memory. → Session
volcengine/OpenViking.quick_start:
pip install openviking --upgrade
openviking-server init      # interactive wizard: providers, models, ov.conf
openviking-server doctor    # validate setup
openviking-server           # start (background: nohup openviking-server > openviking.log 2>&1 &)

analysis.positioning: OpenViking 是一个面向 AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，旨在统一代理记忆、知识检索（RAG）和技能管理。它通过类似文件系统的 URI 和分层上下文加载，解决代理上下文管理碎片化、token 消耗高和检索结果缺乏可解释性的问题。与普通向量数据库或 RAG 工具相比，其明确特点是提供确定性的上下文寻址、分层存储和可观测的检索轨迹。
target_users: AI 代理开发者，需要管理长期记忆和上下文。
构建 RAG 应用的团队，希望降低 token 成本并提升检索可解释性。
需要将技能、资源和记忆统一管理的智能体平台开发者。
core_capabilities: 统一上下文寻址：通过 viking:// URI 将记忆、资源和技能映射为文件系统，使代理能像操作文件一样确定性地定位和操作上下文。
分层加载降低 token 消耗：写入时生成 L0/L1/L2 三层抽象，按任务需求加载对应深度，减少不必要的 token 开销。
目录递归检索：先定位高相关目录，再逐层深入，返回结果时保留完整上下文，提升检索准确性。
可观测检索：保留每次查询的目录浏览轨迹，便于调试和验证检索路径。
会话记忆沉淀：会话提交后异步提取用户偏好和代理经验，转化为长期记忆，实现自进化。
technical_analysis: 语言为 Python，提供 pip 安装和命令行工具，部署方式为本地服务器，支持后台运行。
集成形态为独立服务，通过初始化向导配置 providers 和模型，并提供 doctor 命令验证设置。
从现有信息看，其架构围绕 URI 文件系统、分层存储和异步记忆提取设计，但未提供具体技术实现细节，需进一步核实。

chaitanyagiri/munder-difflin.readme_summary: **Free, open source and performant** — a multi-agent harness that works with the subscriptions you already pay for, on their hourly limits. It turns the terminal coding CLI you already run into a clone of you, one that keeps working while you're away and coordinates a whole office of agents on your own machine.
readme_features: Every terminal is a real agent. Claude Code, Antigravity (Gemini), OpenAI Codex, xAI Grok, Kimi Code, Qwen, OpenCode, Crush, pi.dev, GitHub Copilot CLI, or a custom command — each in its own node-pty PTY, rendered with xterm.js.
Every agent is an avatar. A Pixi.js office floor where agents walk to stations, envelopes fly desk to desk, and avatar state reflects real work.
A GOD orchestrator you talk to. It routes tasks, adjudicates traffic, and escalates only what needs a human. Or press Talk and run the floor by voice.
Per-agent git worktrees. Optional isolation so parallel agents never collide on branches.
The hive — per-agent memory, atomic-file mailboxes, a shared blackboard, an append-only event log, single-committer git.
